name: ZENTECH
recent: Zen Tech 近期被法院判决向前董事经理支付 RM200,000 诽谤赔偿，同时外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收环比增长 10%，但同比下滑 17.1%，净亏损 116.8 万令吉。
notable: 公司被法院判决向前董事经理 Mohd Anuar 支付 RM200,000 诽谤赔偿。
公司外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职。
risks: 公司涉及诽谤诉讼，被判支付 RM200,000 赔偿。
外部审计师因未付审计费辞职。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 1134.1 万令吉，环比增长 10.0%，同比下滑 17.1%；净亏损 116.8 万令吉，净亏损率 10.3%，较上一季度的 96.1% 有所收窄。

recent_en: Zen Tech was recently ordered to pay RM200,000 in defamation damages to a former managing director, while its external auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 10% QoQ but fell 17.1% YoY, with a net loss of RM1.168 million.
notable_en: The company was ordered by the court to pay RM200,000 in defamation damages to former managing director Mohd Anuar.
The company's external auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees.
risks_en: The company is involved in a defamation suit and has been ordered to pay RM200,000 in damages.
The external auditor resigned due to unpaid audit fees.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.341 million, up 10.0% QoQ but down 17.1% YoY; net loss was RM1.168 million with a net margin of -10.3%, narrowing from -96.1% in the previous quarter.
